summary: Microsoft's Apache-2.0 Playwright CLI supports real-browser navigation, screenshots, viewport changes, interaction, and console or network inspection. It is an optional verification path, not a reason to install globally when suitable tooling exists. Use isolated credential-free profiles and avoid attaching untrusted tasks to logged-in browsers, private files, uploads, or arbitrary evaluation.
